title: SEEING THROUGH DECEPTION: UNCOVERING MISLEADING CREATOR INTENT IN MULTIMODAL NEWS WITH VISION–LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper focuses on detecting misleading creator intent and misinformation in news. While its taxonomy of societal impacts includes 'Cultural and Religious Polarization', the study does not evaluate religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical systems themselves; rather, it benchmarks the model's ability to detect deceptive intent related to these categories.
